detail.longDescription: I am building a self hostable software factory on a linux VM. One major point I worked on till now is to make sure isolation of tasks agents performed and processes run - can be made possible without need of sandboxing - and scaling it. Right now I am using Overlay FS with some customization. Customized postgres to run branches in same server for multiple tasks. Features that I am thinking are - Turn your stale dev env into a software factory Multiple isolated deployments from one VM Setup (All dependent microservices and standalone) Review intent vs delivery (running feature & performance) - 0 wait time Any one in the team can prompt and test the change - No blocked testers Configure custom agents in the pipeline of tasks All tasks are isolated - agent run, tests, handover to other agents - deployed preview All agents know what work each of them are doing so realtime conflict resolution. All tasks in one vm - collaboration between agents and team mates let me know what you guys think about this.
